name: Account Settings
summary: Passive account-preference section shell with heading-labelled sections and a target-documented per-section mixture of explicit canonical Forms, truly immediate controls, policy-backed consent, and platform handoffs.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Passive generic container that supplies only Account Settings measure and composition rhythm.

anatomy.name: section
anatomy.description: Repeated native thematic section labelled by its visible contextual heading.

anatomy.name: sectionHeader
anatomy.description: Section title and optional-description copy group.

anatomy.name: sectionTitle
anatomy.description: Non-empty visible contextual heading with a unique ID that labels its section.

anatomy.name: sectionDescription
anatomy.description: Optional visible explanatory copy with a stable ID for target-owned description relationships.

anatomy.name: sectionContent
anatomy.description: Target-owned composition region for canonical Forms, controls, actions, and non-persistence content.

anatomy.name: controls
anatomy.description: Optional visual stack for a target-labelled related-control group; target composition chooses role=group or Fieldset semantics.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Neutral account-settings section shell without a data-provider or persistence variant.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic fluid shell with a private maximum measure and child-owned responsive behavior.

states.name: default
states.description: One or more complete target-defined titled sections.

states.name: withDescription
states.description: Optional visible section explanation is present.

states.name: withControlGroup
states.description: Target composition presents related controls as one labelled group.

states.name: explicitSaveSection
states.description: A deferred section composes its coherent canonical Form and deliberate submit lifecycle.

states.name: immediateSection
states.description: A section contains effects that truly apply at activation and remain outside unrelated Form submission.

states.name: lastSection
states.description: Final section omits the visual divider without changing semantics.

behavior.name: passiveShell
attributes: no root form or widget role
behavior.description: The root owns only layout. It has no submit, change, request, storage, validation, authentication, status, or routing behavior.

behavior.name: labelledSections
behavior.description: Every repeated thematic section has one visible non-empty contextual heading; heading rank remains target owned.

behavior.name: canonicalComposition
behavior.description: Targets compose canonical Form, Input, Button, Switch, Fieldset, Checkbox, and feedback components without U9 copying their anatomy or behavior.

behavior.name: documentedCommitmentLifecycle
behavior.description: Each target documents one truthful commitment lifecycle per section. A global Form is valid only when every included setting is coherently deferred; a Switch remains immediate and never waits for an unrelated Save action.

behavior.name: explicitSaveSection
behavior.description: Profile-like deferred edits compose canonical Form and submit deliberately. The target owns dirty state, validation, pending, failure, conflict, authentication expiry, confirmed feedback, focus, and refresh.

behavior.name: immediateControlSection
behavior.description: Effects that truly apply at activation compose canonical Switch outside any global Save action. A provisional binary value awaiting submission uses Checkbox or another appropriate deferred control instead.

behavior.name: policyBackedConsent
behavior.description: Marketing, notification, privacy, and other regulated consent remain policy-backed target records with their own copy, evidence, timestamps, source, unsubscribe or confirmation lifecycle; U9 never models them as generic booleans.

behavior.name: platformHostedHandoff
behavior.description: Settings owned by the platform are linked or omitted rather than copied into a neutral flow that cannot preserve provider authentication, policy, mutation, and recovery semantics.

behavior.name: childStateOwnership
behavior.description: Form and controls own native or adapter-controlled state/events. Targets own writable account truth, section inventory, requests, reconciliation, focus, announcements, audit history, privacy, and analytics.

behavior.name: responsiveContainer
behavior.description: The shell contains long and narrow content through logical sizing while child dependencies respond to their own containers.

properties.name: sections
properties.description: Non-empty target-owned titled sections containing canonical explicit Forms, truly immediate controls, policy-backed consent composition, links to platform-hosted settings, or non-persistence content. Each section has one documented commitment lifecycle; no fixed account schema is implied.

accessibility: Use a passive generic root and native thematic sections; give each section one non-empty visible contextual heading with a unique ID and aria-labelledby.
Preserve logical heading rank selected by the page or target context; U9 does not force a page heading level.
Compose canonical visible labels, native names/values, autocomplete purposes, checked state, validation, focus, keyboard, forced-color, and reduced-motion behavior from child controls.
Use a labelled group or Fieldset when target composition presents related Switches or other controls as one logical group; reference relevant visible description text.
Do not place an immediate Switch behind a generic Save action. Use a canonical deferred control when a binary choice does not take effect until Form submission.
Keep policy-backed notification, marketing, privacy, and consent records distinct from generic immediate preferences; preserve target copy, evidence, confirmation, revocation, and audit requirements.
Link to or omit platform-hosted settings when neutral composition cannot preserve the provider's authentication, mutation, policy, and recovery lifecycle.
Keep target-inserted pending, success, and failure feedback outside U9 or in the owning Form/feedback component; render no empty live region.
Protect account data through target authentication, authorization, privacy, consent, and protected-customer-data policy rather than U9 presentation.

web.notes: Passive div and heading-labelled section structure implemented in components/css/account.css with canonical child composition and zero U9 runtime.

shopify.notes: Map each section separately to a supported customer-account profile/block/full-page extension, authenticated service, policy-backed consent mutation, hosted setting link, or omission. Current Shopify Switch is for immediate effects and explicitly recommends Checkbox for values requiring submission. Copied theme CSS is not target-native readiness.
